# ankra_morpheus_layouts (Data Source)

The HPE Morpheus instance-type layouts behind a credential, for `layout_id` on `ankra_morpheus_cluster`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster morpheus layouts`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_morpheus_layouts" "all" {
  credential_id = ankra_morpheus_credential.main.id
}

output "morpheus_layouts" {
  value = { for layout in data.ankra_morpheus_layouts.all.layouts : layout.name => layout.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.

### Read-Only

- `layouts` (Attributes List) Layouts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layouts))

<a id="nestedatt--layouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layouts`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Layout id.
- `instance_type_id` (Number) Id of the instance type the layout belongs to.
- `instance_type_name` (String) Name of the instance type the layout belongs to.
- `name` (String) Layout name.
- `provision_type` (String) Provision type, when reported.
